cases.question: Is the Receive updates checkbox checked?

cases.text: Plan panel. Radio options Standard and Extended.
cases.question: Is Standard the selected radio option?
cases.true: The Standard circle has a filled center.
cases.false: The Standard circle is empty and Extended has a filled center.

cases.text: Service panel. Labels Service status and Status legend.
cases.question: Does the Service status indicator signify healthy according to the visible legend?
cases.true: The indicator matches the legend color for Healthy.
cases.false: It matches the legend color for Fault.

cases.text: Workspace panel. Controls Save and Cancel; a dialog may overlay the workspace.
cases.question: Is the Save button fully visible and unobscured?
cases.true: The full Save button is visible outside an overlay.
cases.false: An opaque dialog covers the Save button's position.

cases.text: Chart panel. A vertical Load bar and a dashed threshold at 60.
cases.question: Does the Load bar rise above the 60 threshold line?
cases.true: The top of the Load bar is above the 60 line.
cases.false: The top of the Load bar is below the 60 line.

cases.text: Access panel. A padlock icon and the label Workspace access.
cases.question: Is the padlock closed?
cases.true: Both shackle ends are connected to the lock body.
cases.false: One shackle end is visibly raised free of the lock body.
